hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if [ -z "$FILE_PATH" ]; then exit 0; fi; EXT="${FILE_PATH##*.}"; case "$EXT" in dart) dart format -l 120 "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null;; js|jsx|ts|tsx|json|css|md) npx prettier --write "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null;; py) python3 -m black "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null;; go) gofmt -w "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null;; rs) rustfmt "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0
